title: Sagalee Gaarreen Walitti Makame
intro: Lubbuun qajeeltuu samii irraa kennaa adda ta’e kennameefii, bulchaa fi loltuu uumamni isaa uumama mataa isaa wajjin kan wal qabate fakkaatu taate. Seenaan isaanii raajii, mootummaa fi ogummaa harkaatiin kan hodhamu yoo ta’u, hambaa fuula mul’ata waaqaa keessaa sagalee dhageessisu dhiisa.
clues: Gabricha Rabbii ta’ee filatamee ummata filatame keessaa mootummaa jabaa naaf kenneef.
Gaarreen fi simbirroonni Hunda Ol Aanaa ulfina kennuu keessatti na waliin ni dhaga’amu turan.
Sibiilli akka suphee harka kootti lallaafaa ta’e, fedhii Rabbii qofaan.
Meeshaa waraanaa ittisaa kan loltoota hoʼa lolaa keessatti gaachana taʼan hojjedheera.
Yeroo tokko namoota wal falman lama osoon hin yaadin bakka waaqeffannaa kootti cabsanii yeroo seenan qormaata ulfaataa darbe.
Ani bulchaa qilleensaa fi jinni ajaju cinatti caqafameera — bulchaan sun sanyii mataa koo waan ta’eef.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Wal falmitoonni lama bakka waaqeffannaa koo cabsanii seenan
Lolaa guddaa saba koo balleesse mudate
Qurxummii guddaa tokkoon liqimfame
Ummata kootiin ibidda boba'aa keessa darbatame
Maatii fi qabeenya hunda dhabuudhaan qoratame
trial.answer: Wal falmitoonni lama bakka waaqeffannaa koo cabsanii seenan

location.label: Qaama Ijoo
options: Sibiilli harka koo keessatti pliable godhame
Qurxummii guddaa gadi fagoo
Ulee gara bofaatti jijjiirame
Iddoo biqiltuu ajaa'ibaa oomisha gosa lama qabu
Gaara qulqulluu Tur jedhamu
location.answer: Sibiilli harka koo keessatti pliable godhame

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Faarfannaa (Zabuur) fudhatee akka bulchaa haqaatti hundeeffame
Garaa qurxummii keessaa baraaramee namoonni amanan
Uummata koo harka gabroomfataa jalaa baase
Bubbee fi jinni irratti ol’aantummaa kenneef
Fayyaatti deebi'ee eebba kana caalu kennameef
outcome.answer: Faarfannaa (Zabuur) fudhatee akka bulchaa haqaatti hundeeffame

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
